settings.definition_quote: If we pull an arm i ∈ [k], we get its reward, and we trigger an evolution of the expected reward of the arm i and of all the arms connected to i. ... In this section, we propose a novel algorithm to solve the deterministic GTRB, i.e., all instances of GTRB where σ = 0.
